OUR MISSION

Connect the full therapy journey - from physician awareness to refill - on one signal layer.

  1. Awareness
  2. Consideration
  3. First Fill
  4. Adherence
  5. Refill

Most adtech moves clicks. Doceree moves prescriptions, first fills, and refills - the moments that actually change a patient's life. Every layer of the operating system we're building, from identity to intent to outcomes, exists because a physician somewhere is trying to make a decision and a patient somewhere is waiting for a therapy that works.

If you've been looking for engineering or commercial work where the unit of impact is a patient outcome rather than a campaign metric, this is that place.

02WHAT YOU GET TO BUILD

Real systems. Frontier AI. Real outcomes.

Doceree isn't an AI feature bolted onto a legacy platform. Every layer of our stack is being built in-house, in production, with the most regulated industry on earth as the customer. The technical and commercial problems here are unusually deep.

Step 01

Build with frontier-class AI

Agentic workflows on Claude and GPT-5 class models. LangGraph orchestration. MLR-native content generation. RepTwin's AI field force. Daily Command's AI-native command center. The AI work here is genuinely on the frontier.

Claude · GPT-5 classLangGraphMLR-nativeAgentic workflows
Step 02

Work on the only signal graph in healthcare

Espyian, our deterministic HCP identity layer, is the foundation everything else runs on. CIS is the real-time intent layer on top. If you're a data engineer or backend engineer, this is one of the most interesting graph problems in the industry.

Espyian · identityCIS · intentDeterministic
Step 03

Ship to a real customer base

115+ pharmaceutical brands. 30+ media agencies. Health systems and publishers across four markets. Your work isn't a research project - it's running campaigns and influencing prescriptions today.

115+Pharma brands30+Agencies4Markets
Step 04

Solve healthcare's hardest constraints

HIPAA. SOC 2. GDPR. CCPA. MLR. Every system we build has to be compliant, audited, and trusted by pharma legal teams. If you love engineering with real constraints, this work will sharpen you.

Audit-readyPharma legal trustReal-world constraints

Small teams. High ownership. Big problems.

Doceree teams are deliberately small and unusually empowered. A product engineer can ship to production on day three. A business development manager can take a six-figure pharma deal from cold to close. A data engineer can rebuild a layer of the identity graph on their own conviction.

We move fast because the people we hire don't wait for permission to do the obvious thing. We tell the truth in writing. We default to documenting decisions, not relitigating them. And we believe the best ideas usually come from the person closest to the problem - not the person furthest up the org chart.

Bias to ship

A working v1 in production beats a perfect v2 in a doc. Real users sharpen real product faster than any internal review.

Tell the truth in writing

Honest written communication is faster than careful verbal communication. We prefer the document over the meeting.

Outcomes over outputs

The unit of value is a patient outcome and a customer result - not a feature shipped or a deck delivered.

Built around the work, and the life around it.

Compensation should reward the impact you make. The rest should make it easy to do your best work without trading off the rest of your life.

01

Competitive compensation

Cash and equity benchmarked to top quartile across each market. Aligned to long-term value creation, not quarterly metrics.

02

Flexible work environment

Hybrid by default. Office hubs in Noida, London, and New Jersey. Remote roles for the right people.

03

Learning & development

An annual learning budget. Conference attendance. Internal AI and product-craft sessions. We pay you to get sharper.

04

Health & wellbeing

Comprehensive medical coverage, mental health support, and time off to actually use. We're a healthcare company - we mean it.

05

Equity in the company

Real ownership in a company building the operating system for a $50B industry. Your upside is tied to the OS we're shipping.

06

Inclusive culture

Diverse teams across four markets. Hiring against capability and judgment - not credentials or pedigree.

07

Career velocity

In a small-team, high-ownership company, scope grows with capability. Strong performers move faster than they would anywhere else.

08

Tools that don't get in the way

Best-in-class hardware, AI tools at every workflow, and engineering platforms that respect your time.

05LIFE AT DOCEREE

Real moments. Real people.

Off-sites, all-hands, demo days, after-hours dance breaks - a few snapshots of what it's actually like to be here.
